sources.label: VORON Trident R2
sources.author: VoronDesign
sources.scope: Independent standard Trident 250 / 300 / 350 chassis, fixed frame, three Z guides, moving bed and 6 mm R2 gantries.
sources.changes: Rigid native hardware retains its dimensions. Size-specific rails preserve native periodic hole pitch and fixing axes. Extrusions, bed and panels use central or perimeter inserts. Static mounting references and native Z limits remain disclosed.

sources.label: VORON V2.4 R2
sources.author: VoronDesign
sources.scope: Printed R2 assemblies in 250 / 300 / 350 mm, derived from the official 250 mm assembly.
sources.changes: 350 mm寸法への再配置。選択部品の重複を除き、スカート・ラッチ・固定具・ベッドの取付面を調整。 Zレール固定用ナットをM3へ交換してレール裏の溝へ配置。XYを含む68組のレール固定ナットをボルト軸に合わせて調整。 Complete 250/300/350 upper and lower latch groups are registered to the door seam and native magnet recesses.

sources.label: Stealthburner / Clockwork 2 / Revo CAD
sources.author: VoronDesign
sources.scope: SBのRevo Voron・Rapido HF・Dragon SF/HF・V6用CW2マウント、前面本体、CW2修復用形状。
sources.changes: 配置・表示用三角形化・配色の調整。機種ごとの変更履歴を検証記録に保存。

changes: V2.4 custom 500 and half-height 350 skirts, connector bodies and fasteners are rigidly registered to native mounting features. Two side screw bearing faces are aligned to their original seats. Purchased geometry and mesh surface buffers remain unchanged. Selected native screw body intersections and cylindrical mating axes are checked; full-printer continuous clearance is not certified.
supports: No new built-in support removal was performed. Retained source notices apply.
source_format: Editable individual native BREP solids with exact part manifests, hash pins, dimensions and operation evidence. Geometry keeps upstream and component terms.

source_repositories.label: VORON V2.4 R2
source_repositories.author: VoronDesign
source_repositories.scope: 250の公式アセンブリから構築したV2.4 350基準モデル。
source_repositories.changes: 350 mm寸法への再配置。選択部品の重複を除き、スカート・ラッチ・固定具・ベッドの取付面を調整。 Zレール固定用ナットをM3へ交換してレール裏の溝へ配置。XYを含む68組のレール固定ナットをボルト軸に合わせて調整。 Complete 250/300/350 upper and lower latch groups are registered to the door seam and native magnet recesses.

notices: Custom dimensions derived from native VORON 350 mm reference parts. Rigid hardware retains native dimensions.
Printed skirt sections are extended custom parts. This is not an official VORON size or a tested build kit.
Moving belts are smooth route previews; teeth, tension and electrical wiring mechanics are not simulated.
Skirt, connector and fastener placements follow native mounting features. Purchased parts retain their original geometry. This checks selected skirt interfaces, not full-printer physical clearance.
